items.title: Implement evaluateDecompositionGate in new core/parallel-decomposition-gate.ts: pure verdict (advisories plus first block) over story/peers/contracts/cfg per spec 4.3/4.4, consuming the Story-1 overlap engine; no cfg.mode enforcement
items.context: new file core/parallel-decomposition-gate.ts; import computeWriteSet/globsOverlap/classifyBroadness from parallel-decomposition-overlap.js plus types from parallel-decomposition.js; filter active peers via terminalPhases = {DONE, DISCARDED} (reuse parallel-policy.ts); the four block reasons with tier-1 vs tier-2 (advisory) split, broadGlobBlocks config-gating, fake_dependency_chain falsifiable-only, peer_contract_unreadable_parallel

happy.desc: evaluateDecompositionGate with two disjoint parallel peers (no overlapping paths, no broad globs, all contracts present) -> block=null AND advisories is empty array; WHY: proves the clean-path baseline

Two parallel stories with literal exact-path intersection in allowedCreate -> block=overlap_declared_parallel citing the colliding path and peer storyId; WHY: proves tier-1 hard block fires on provable file collision
TERMINAL_PHASES is exported from parallel-policy.ts as a ReadonlySet containing DONE and DISCARDED; WHY: proves the single-source refactor landed and the gate can import it
Peer with missing contract AND parallelSafe=yes -> block=peer_contract_unreadable_parallel citing that peer; WHY: proves unreadable peer contract triggers fail-closed block
Story with broad glob in writeSet AND broadGlobBlocks=true -> block=broad_glob_unprovable_parallel; WHY: proves config-gated broad-glob blocking

edge.desc: Peer in phase DONE is excluded from activePeers even if it has overlapping path -> block=null; WHY: proves TERMINAL_PHASES filtering for DONE
Peer in phase DISCARDED is excluded from activePeers even if it has overlapping path -> block=null; WHY: proves TERMINAL_PHASES filtering for DISCARDED
Non-parallel story (parallelSafe=no) overlapping a parallel peer -> block=null (no parallel-specific block); WHY: proves gate does not hard-block non-parallel story even on overlap
Broad glob with broadGlobBlocks=false -> block=null AND advisory mentions broad glob; WHY: proves config-gating degrades broad-glob to advisory
Tier-2 shared-prefix overlap (dir/* vs dir/other.ts, no literal collision) -> block=null AND advisory mentioning shared-prefix; WHY: proves tier-2 never hard-blocks
depends edge citing storyId NOT among peers -> advisory (fake_dependency_chain), never a block; WHY: proves fake_dependency_chain is advise-only per spec 4.5
Gate never reads cfg.mode -> function returns block reasons regardless of mode value; WHY: proves separation of concerns (mode enforcement is Story 5 caller)

adversarial.desc: Simultaneous overlap AND broad glob: literal path collision AND broad glob present -> block=overlap_declared_parallel (higher precedence); WHY: proves precedence ordering per plan step 9
Peer with parallelSafe=no has overlapping path -> no overlap_declared_parallel block (peer must also assert parallel); WHY: proves block requires BOTH sides to assert parallel
Story own contract missing from Map -> fail-open (block=null, NOT peer_contract_unreadable); WHY: proves self-contract-missing does not self-block per spec 4.8

Multiple peers: one DONE (ignored), one active with overlap, one active with missing contract -> block=overlap_declared_parallel (highest precedence); WHY: proves multi-peer precedence with mixed terminal/active
Zero active peers (all DONE/DISCARDED) with broad glob -> block=null empty advisories; WHY: proves lone-story trivially passes even with broad scope per spec 4.8 no-op

items.title: Hermetic smoke for the gate verdict: each block reason fires on its provable case plus degrades to advisory on the non-provable case; clean disjoint decomposition returns no block
items.context: new task smoke under packages/main/src/tasks/; build StoryInfo/ScopeContractData fixtures in-memory; assert overlap_declared_parallel (tier-1) vs advisory (tier-2), broad block only when broadGlobBlocks, fake_dependency_chain only when symbol absent, peer_contract_unreadable, and a clean parallel set returning block null; register in lattice.config.json

happy.desc: Smoke task runs to completion (exit 0) with all assertions passing when evaluateDecompositionGate is correctly implemented; WHY: proves the smoke harness itself works end-to-end
Smoke asserts clean disjoint parallel set (two parallel stories with non-overlapping paths, all contracts present) -> block=null and no overlap advisory; WHY: baseline happy-path fixture
Smoke asserts tier-1 literal overlap (both parallel, same file) -> block=overlap_declared_parallel citing path+peer; WHY: core provable-collision fixture
Smoke asserts peer_contract_unreadable_parallel when active parallel peer contract is absent from Map; WHY: proves unreadable-peer detection fixture
Smoke asserts broad_glob_unprovable_parallel fires when broadGlobBlocks=true; WHY: proves strict-profile broad-glob blocking fixture
Smoke is registered in lattice.config.json validate.commands so it runs during lattice validate; WHY: proves CI integration

edge.desc: Smoke asserts tier-2 shared-prefix only (dir/* vs dir/literal, no literal collision) -> block=null plus a shared-prefix advisory; WHY: proves tier-2 advisory-only fixture
Smoke asserts broad glob with broadGlobBlocks=false -> block=null plus advisory; WHY: proves config-downgrade fixture
Smoke asserts fake_dependency_chain with depends citing non-existent peer -> advisory only, never a block; WHY: proves advise-only nature per spec 4.5
Smoke asserts DONE peer is ignored (not counted as active) even with overlapping path; WHY: proves terminal-phase exclusion fixture
Smoke asserts non-parallel story (parallelSafe=no) yields no parallel block even on overlap; WHY: proves gate skips blocks for non-parallel stories
Smoke asserts TERMINAL_PHASES imported from parallel-policy.ts (not redefined locally); WHY: proves single-source reuse

adversarial.desc: Smoke asserts precedence: story simultaneously overlapping AND broad -> block=overlap_declared_parallel (not broad_glob); WHY: proves precedence ordering per plan step 9
Smoke asserts precedence: overlap > peer_contract_unreadable > broad_glob when multiple conditions fire simultaneously; WHY: proves full three-way precedence chain
Smoke fixtures use in-memory StoryInfo/ScopeContractData only (no file I/O, no network, no disk reads) -> hermetic; WHY: proves the smoke is truly hermetic and cannot flake on filesystem state
